lines.english: "This is…"
"Yeah, this is the hotel Kazusa's staying in."
Onjuku Integral Hotel, a hotel so imposing that I could spot it even from the window of my apartment, towering over the other skyscrapers in the city's downtown area, right in the center.
"There's someone called Kudou-san waiting in the lobby. She'll take you to Kazusa's room."
The most expensive suite room on the highest floor of this luxurious hotel is where Kazusa has designated her very own Amano-Iwato.
…A far too expensive choice of residence for a person seeking to isolate herself from the world.
"I understand, then things are done for you here, Haruki-kun. I'll be fine on my own from here on out."
"Hey, Setsuna…"
"Hmm?"
"Is it really alright? …For you to take such an awful role…"
"…How many times have you already said that line? I'm sure the number is over three digits by now."
"Still…"
We spent a lot of time preparing and pulled plenty of strings to reach where we are now.
Still, the very moment we're about to put our plan into action, I'd suddenly become very hesitant about it.
"This is all for Kazusa's sake, you know? …That means it's our sake as well."
I'm expecting Setsuna to become Ame-no-Uzume…
Despite the fact that she willingly volunteered for the role, the fact remains that I'm imposing an extremely cruel task on her.
"As I thought… I should be the one to go. I should try to talk to Kazusa just one more time."
"That's impossible, Haruki-kun."
"Everything will be alright. I won't waver anymore…"
"I'm really not worried about that. All I'm worried about is Kazusa right now."
"…Sorry."
Setsuna's not the one who needs to be saved right now, and neither am I, of course…
"Right now, I think neither you nor Youko-san are capable of this. After all, you both love Kazusa far too much."
"You can't scold her, and you're not able to push her away either. …The only thing you two are capable of is spoiling her."
And Setsuna's the one who knows that fact better than anyone else right nowーSetsuna, the one person who has kept getting betrayed until now.
"That's why I have to step in. The one who hasn't met her in five years."
How did I ever manage to get together with someone as amazing as her? Why is someone as wonderful as she is still willing to stay by my side even now?
"Setsuna, I… you know, up until now, I…"
"Ah, let's not talk about those things right now. Let's go back to that after all this is over, okay?"
When was it that Setsuna became such a strong woman?
"I want to only think about Kazusa right now. I want to put my full concentration into thinking about what I can do for her."
Has she always been like this since the first day we met? When we got together? …Or did she become like this following the one time when we separated from one another?
"I understand… I'll leave Kazusa to you, then."
"I wonder how I'm going to do this… maybe I'll only be able to vent on her despite everything I've said. Maybe I'll only manage to let out all my pent-up grudges when I finally see her."
"Gosh, I was just kidding! You could at least stop giving me such a sad look and play along!"
"J-Just kidding…?"
"I'm trying to tell you that there's no need to worry about us fighting or going at each other's throats or something."
"Hang on a second! Even if you are just joking, could you please not say stuff like that…?"
"Yeah, that's how it feels. Well, I suppose it wouldn't be particularly interesting this way… Still, maybe we will end up quarrelling a little."
"Ha, haha…"
Perhaps I was the one who made Setsuna strong by hurting her, and causing her pain over and over again.
"Hey, Haruki-kun…"
"Hmm?"
"The fact that I'm right here at this very moment is all because you worked hard for it, you know?"
"Not at all… I simply sought you out for help and nothing more, Setsuna…"
"Still, you're the very person who's made me who I amーa person who won't break when someone's asking for my help."
"Setsuna…?"
"It's because back then… when you came to see me in Osaka… you gave me a lot of courage…"
"That's…"

"Good luck with your work. …If you happen to make a mistake, focus on finding the reason why you made it. So long as you can do that, you'll be able to perform better next time, even if only by a little."
When I went to depend on Setsuna, I could see that she was driven into a corner far worse than me.
"From the next day on, I spent all my time from dawn till dusk running from one place to the other and apologizing to everyone."
So in an attempt to cover up my own shortcomings, I ran away in that terrible, thoughtless and sanctimonious manner.
"It was my own mistake, but my means of making up for it were limited… I'm still just a new employee, after all."
"I see…"
"In any case, I made sure to keep my mistakes in mind, thinking about where I went wrong… and I did my best to improve, even if only by a little."
"Yeah."

"Even so, I couldn't really get very much done by myself, so I decided to focus on getting better by familiarizing myself with the work, and to follow my instructions with the utmost effort, or at the very least a smile."
"And I found that, so long as I could do that, the atmosphere at work got so much better all of a sudden! It was like all the stuff from the day prior was no big deal at all."
"Right…"
"And in the end, they told me that they were looking forward to seeing me in future events, too… I know it was just a bit of flattery, but it still made me very happy!"
And yet, Setsuna has…
She's really, really done her best, all while she's trying to feel encouraged by words I'd said to deceive her, and all while knowing that there's a possibility that I might've betrayed her.
"You're amazing, Setsuna…"
"How so?"
"The way you think about things and attempt to solve them all by yourself… you're very strong."
She's truly a strong person. Noーshe's become strong.
"Oh no, I owe all this to you, Haruki-kun."
"No. I've done absolutely nothing. There's nothing I've ever done that's warranted your gratitude, Setsuna…"
"But you came! The very moment I really wanted to meet you, you came back to my side."
"I'm not… I'm not the man you think I am, Setsuna…"
"Up until now, you've always shown me your own effort. You've always shown me the way."
"Even if you won't admit it, I will. I'll always believe in you."
The way she is now, Setsuna is truly strongーher heart, her emotions, everything down to her very core…
"That's why it's my turn to do my best now. You've always been working so hard up until now, Haruki-kun, so it's about time you had some rest."
"Setsuna…"
"After all, I've accepted your wishーI've received the baton from your hands."
In that case, I… the best I can do right now is to repay that infallible strength of hers.
"I'll have you know that I'm not the anchor in this race, though."
I should think about how I should return the favor from now on after the limitless compassion she's given me.
"I'll do my best in the one lap I'll be running. And I'll make sure that I'll return the baton to you again."
"I understand… I'll wait for you."
"That's why when the time comes… the three of us will cross that final hurdle together, alright?"
"…! Setsuna…"
I suppose I need to think about how I'm going to spend the rest of my life making up for everything I've done to her.
"Well then, I'll be heading in now."
"I'm counting on you…"
"Yeah, you can count on me."
Perhaps I was never needed by her in the first place.
"I'm begging you, Setsuna… please… please… do something about Kazusa."
Just like when I first met her. When she was Ogiso Setsuna from Class 3-A, school idol and Miss Houjou High. An unattainable flower in my eyes…
"…Alright."
"Thank you for taking care of me all this time. I'm Ogiso… from Knights Records."
"Umm, good evening. Well… it's Setsuna."
"I'm really sorry about yesterday. Does it still hurt?"
"I know that you really don't want to see me again after what I did to you…"
"But if you're willing, could you please open the door? I want to properly apologize for what happened yesterday."
"And if we're able to put aside our differences, I really want us to get back to business with our work again…"
"I wonder if you're asleep…?"
"Or maybe you really just don't want to see me anymore?"
"If you really can't see me today, I'll come back some other time. So please at least answer me."
"…Are you really asleep? Or maybe you're not feeling well?"
"Could you at least… let me hear your voice?"
"…Huh?"
"Like I said, Kazusa's giving me no response! I can't hear anything from her room either, not her voice, and not even the ringtone of her cell phone!"
"What do I do, what do I do…!? It's all because of the horrible things I did yesterday that… I might've pushed Kazusa to the edge!"
"I'm sorry, Haruki-kun… I'm so sorry! If only I'd kept close watch on her… no, it's because I've been so pushy with her that this ended up happening!"
"Y-Yeah… I am calm, and I'm alright. Like I said, I am being calm! More importantly, we need to help Kazusa!"
"Yes, we should call for help. Maybe the police and an ambulance and… is there anything else? Ah, right, I should ask the front desk first!"
"Alright, I'll tell them to unlock her room immediately. I'll contact you as soon as I can after that!"
"Eh?"
"Yes, Touma-sama left the hotel some time ago."
"…Um, could you perhaps be Ogiso-sama, by any chance? If that's the case, I do have a message meant for you."
"Kazusaaaaaa…!"
"What in the world happened?"
"Jeez, don't scare me like that! I… I… I thought you were…!"
"You thought I'd cut my wrists in the bathroom? That I'd hanged myself in the closet? That I'd jumped out the window of my room?"
"That's… well, um… y-you know, I lost my head a bit at the time!"
"So you really thought of it that way…"
"Of course I would! Why would you suddenly have the urge to go out today? …Was it because you knew I would be coming today?"
"No reason, really, I just didn't want you to bother me, Setsuna."
"So I wasn't entirely wrong…"
"It's just that I started missing this thing."
"Ah…"
"In any case, it's being a real piece of work. …Even the slightest downtime between us seems to have made it hard to work with."
"Kazusa…"
"Though I suppose it's natural, given how much I've been ignoring it ever since I returned to Japan. It seems to be quite upset, judging by how it keeps slipping under my fingers."
"Does this mean that… you're willing to do the concert?"
"…I'm not going to work on the CD even if it kills me, though."
"That doesn't matter right now. More importantly… have you gotten the urge to play again?"
"…I'm still quite lost about it."
"Is that so…"
"I don't think I can produce my best performance in just two weeks. …I don't think my heart will return even if my skill does."
"But I can't bring myself to run away from everything just because of that anymore."
"Perhaps you've managed to become a little more optimistic?"
"Well, it's not like I enjoy seeing other people upset either… In fact, I'd even say that I hate seeing people upset."
"Yeah, go on."
"There's my mom, Miyoko-san, and… well, even you, Setsuna. It's been hard for me to watch everyone look at me as if they're praying for me…"
"…It seems you've intentionally excluded a certain someone from that list."
"Just when I was so absorbed in such a depressing atmosphere, I happened to receive a letter last night… from Shibata-san."
"Ah, you mean that helper you had back when you were still staying in Japan?"
"She wrote to me to thank me for the ticket for the additional concert I gave her. She said that she'd make sure not to miss it."
"I see… That's good to hear, or is it okay for me to say that?"
"It's odd, isn't it? I don't remember sending anything like that to her."
"…Aaah～!"
"As always, he has one hell of a knack for putting me in sticky situations and poking me where it hurts… I can't bear him."
"He really is unbearable… that coward."
"And there I was feeling relieved that he wasn't showing up anymore… How can he possibly be so bad at reading the mood every time?"
"It's amazing anyone can bear him… that coward."
"That's why I thought I'd at least move my fingers a bit. That would allow me to get in shape if I happen to get the urge to play again."
"Yes… yes! You really are getting more optimistic now! I'm so happy, Kazusa…"
"I just said I'm not doing the CD, you know? I haven't said a single thing that would be to your benefit, Setsuna."
"Hey, can I stay here and listen to your piano, Kazusa?"
"Let's see… as long as you don't fall asleep halfway through."
"Jeez, you know that I wouldn't possibly do something so wasteful, now, would I?"
"…Is that so?"
"…By the way, Setsuna, did you really go to work today with your face looking like that?"
"Well, now that you mention it! Everyone was tiptoeing around me all day like I was one step away from blowing up, you know!? …Well, I was all swollen, so I suppose I did look the part."
"You dummy."
